instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: Health insurance provider offering individual and group health plans to 50,000 members with a network of 1,200 contracted providers. Key operational priorities are automated pre-authorization processing and provider cost analytics. Evaluating telehealth integration as a claims cost reduction lever. We operate across multiple locations and have distinct functional leadership for operations, commercial, finance, and technology. Our annual planning process is well-established but can be rigid — mid-cycle innovation funding requires navigating a formal business case approval chain involving 3-4 stakeholders.
answers.pastInitiatives: We piloted a cloud-based project management tool last year, but adoption was inconsistent across teams and we ultimately reverted to spreadsheets and email for most project tracking. The experience highlighted that tool adoption requires more structured change management than we initially planned for.
answers.strategicGoals: The board has mandated that 25% of revenue should come from products or services that did not exist 3 years ago. This requires us to systematically explore adjacent markets, new customer segments, and alternative monetization models. We are open to both organic build initiatives and strategic acquisitions of small, innovative companies that can serve as diversification platforms.
answers.teamSize: The technology organization is structured into product-aligned squads with a central platform team of 5 engineers enabling shared infrastructure. Innovation is driven by a '20% time' policy where all engineers can dedicate one day per sprint to self-directed projects, plus a quarterly internal pitch competition where winning ideas receive seed funding and 3 months of dedicated squad allocation.

input.changes_since_last: Hired 4 new team members. Launched customer feedback pilot. Budget for innovation increased 25%.

opportunities.title: Systematic Adjacent Market Diversification Funnel
opportunities.rationale: The board has mandated 25% of revenue from non-existent sources, requiring a systematic exploration beyond core insurance lines. This opportunity focuses on structuring the search for new markets, assessing partnership viability, and prioritizing potential acquisition targets.

first_actions: Establish an interdepartmental 'Market Scan' task force (Commercial + Strategy).
Conduct a detailed competitive landscape analysis of three adjacent high-growth sectors (e.g., preventative care, wellness tech).
Develop a preliminary scoring model for potential acquisition targets based on technology fit and market penetration.
resources_needed: Dedicated consulting budget for external market benchmarking.
2 FTEs from the Strategy/Commercial teams (ring-fenced time).
execution_plan.success_metric: Identification and formal qualification of 5 viable new revenue streams or potential acquisition targets.
milestones: Completion of initial market mapping within Q1.
Prioritization of the top two most promising diversification paths (organic vs. acquisition).

opportunities.title: Creating a Structured Internal Innovation Venture Engine
opportunities.rationale: The failure of previous tool adoption and the current reliance on informal process management highlight an underlying structural weakness. This opportunity is radical because it requires embedding formal change governance and systematically scaling '20% time' into predictable, funded outputs.

first_actions: Design and pilot a mandatory Innovation Proposal Gate (Gate 1) before any dedicated sprint work begins.
Formalize the criteria for internal investment funding (Seed Fund pitch requirements).
Develop standardized 'Innovation Project Charters' that mandate clear operational handoff and adoption metrics upon completion.
resources_needed: Leadership sponsorship to enforce new governance rules across silos.
execution_plan.success_metric: Successful execution and formal adoption of at least two projects originating from the '20% time' pool within 1 year.
milestones: Establishment and rollout of the Innovation Proposal Gate 1 in Q2.
Tracking and reporting on the ROI/adoption rate for internally funded initiatives.

next_steps.action: Formalize the innovation funnel governance (Gate 1 review) to ensure all '20% time' projects follow a structured progression.
Conduct stakeholder workshops focused on breaking down functional silos to improve cross-departmental adoption metrics, focusing specifically on claims processing and provider data exchange.
Establish a dedicated cross-functional working group to map out the end-to-end customer journey for telehealth integration, quantifying potential savings at each stage.

key_weaknesses: Siloed functional leadership and operational dependencies create friction during large-scale adoption of new technologies.
Innovation governance is still weak; processes are highly dependent on individual effort rather than standardized, enforced systems (lack of process maturity).
Resistance to change remains a cultural barrier, particularly concerning the shift from established annual planning cycles to agile, mid-cycle innovation funding.

improvements: Increased dedicated budget for innovation by 25%, providing greater financial mandate.
Established structured technical capacity via product-aligned squads and central platform teams, improving execution muscle.
Successfully launched customer feedback mechanisms (pilot), transforming abstract insights into actionable data.
persistent_gaps: Lack of consistency in change management: Pilot adoption failed due to insufficient structured rollout/training.
Strategy remains too high-level; translating the 'diversification' mandate into specific, measurable product roadmaps is incomplete.
Decision making, while improving (small leadership team), still requires navigating complex stakeholder politics.
achieved_milestones: Successfully completed a key initial initiative (opp_3), proving internal capacity for project closure and review.
Secured measurable commitment from the board regarding strategic diversification goals.

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: The company has moved from an 'informal' state to a structured 'partial' process maturity level. The strategic focus has sharpened dramatically on diversification, supported by increased budget and the creation of defined technical squads.
